title: Revenge of the DOGS!
description: Kill dog = death. Have to protect mans best friend...
body:
Worried about your dog? If so this mod is what you want... If you kill a dog you die, simple as that and it gives a deterant to killing dogs. I mean why would anyone want to ever kill mans best friend am I right?...
